## About Lemmo
risks: Bringing a new e-bike platform to market is a complex process. APV has gone through multiple rounds of design, prototyping, and testing, but there are still risks involved as we move toward final production and delivery. The main challenges may include component lead times, final engineering validation, certification requirements, production scheduling, quality control, international shipping, customs clearance, and potential changes in duties or tariffs. Because APV is a full e-bike platform, some details may also be refined as we complete final testing and prepare for mass production. LEMMO is not starting from scratch. We have already built and delivered e-bikes across Europe and APAC, supported by 200+ sales partners, 100+ service points, and 24/7 professional online support. Our team is working closely with experienced manufacturing, supply chain, and logistics partners to reduce risk and keep the project on track. If timelines, specifications, shipping costs, or delivery plans change, we will communicate clearly with backers through regular Kickstarter updates. Our priority is to deliver APV responsibly, with the quality, safety, and real-world usability expected from LEMMO.

faq.q: About Lemmo | What does APV mean?
faq.a:
APV stands for All-Purpose Vehicle.
Lemmo APV is a new mobility category that combines the flexibility of a longtail e-bike with the capability and utility of a light electric moped.
It is designed to support a wide range of everyday journeys, including commuting, carrying children, transporting cargo, weekend rides, and trips beyond the city.
Our goal is to create a vehicle that can help families handle more of their everyday mobility needs and potentially reduce reliance on a second car for ce…

Lemmo is an innovation-driven personal mobility company founded in Berlin, Germany, in 2022.
We are restructuring micro-mobility into 3 new categories of vehicles,
DMV — Dual Mode Vehicle: combining the flexibility of a bicycle with the performance of an e-bike.
APV — All-Purpose Vehicle: combining the everyday practicality of an e-bike with the capability and utility of a light electric moped.
POD — Personal Omni Drive: exploring the space between lightweight electric mobility and compact cars.…

faq.q: About Lemmo | Who is APV designed for?
faq.a:
APV is designed for next-generation families, makers, tech nomads, and anyone looking for a more versatile way to commute, carry what they need, and spend more time outdoors with the people they care about.
It is made for people who embrace innovation, enjoy exploring new possibilities, and want to support the team seeking possibilities and breaking limitations.

faq.q: Shipping & Delivery | Why are local VAT/GST and shipping fees excluded from the listed prices? How will they be calculated?
faq.a:
The listed Kickstarter pledge amounts exclude local VAT, GST or sales tax and shipping fees. These costs vary depending on your delivery address.

Closer to dispatch, you will receive an email from Kickstarter Pledge Manager to enter or confirm your shipping address and pay the applicable taxes and shipping fees. These charges will be calculated based on your final shipping address.

faq.q: Drivetrain & Motor | What is the main difference between the E-Derailleur Chain Drive and the Internal Gear Hub Belt Drive (+€169)?
faq.a:
E-Derailleur Chain Drive: Features an electronic derailleur paired with Lemmo's multi-sensor AI algorithm to precisely control gear ratios. Advantages include lighter weight, wider gear range, and higher efficiency. Requires regular chain lubrication and maintenance.
Internal Gear Hub Belt Drive: The gear-hub shifting mechanism is integrated inside the motor (invisible from the outside) and pairs with a clean belt drive. Automatic shifting is independently managed by an internal centrifugal-forc…

faq.q: Drivetrain & Motor | Which drivetrain option should I choose for my daily routes (flat city streets vs. steep hills)?
faq.a: Both solutions offer sufficient gear ranges and support automatic shifting. If you prioritize performance, choose the E-Derailleur version. If you prioritize ease of use, cleanliness, and low maintenance, the Belt Drive version is your best choice.

faq.q: Drivetrain & Motor | How does the AI-powered Intelligent Auto Shifting work? Can I still shift gears manually?
faq.a:
Chain Drive Model: Lemmo 3 processes real-time rider and environmental data from multiple sensors to select the correct gear for the E-Derailleur. It accounts for speed, cadence, load, incline, turning, and more.
Belt Drive Model: Automatic shifting is driven by an independent internal motor mechanism controlled by centrifugal force. For details, refer to Bafang GVT motor technology: https://www.bafang-e.com/en/media/blog/blog-post/detail/498

faq.q: Drivetrain & Motor | Is the motor legal in my country? How do the power limits work in the EU, UK, US, and Canada?
faq.a:
Motors on Lemmo 3 delivered to different regions are specifically tuned to match local regulations:
- EU & UK: Pedal assist only, top speed 25 km/h, Bafang H732 motor, 250 W rated power, 1200 W peak power, 90 N·m max torque.
- Canada: Pedal assist and throttle, top speed 20 mph, Bafang H732 motor, 500 W rated power, 1200 W peak power, 90 N·m max torque.
- US: Bafang H732 motor, 750 W rated power, 1200 W peak power, 90 N·m max torque. Class 2 mode supports pedal assist and throttle up to 20 mph;…

faq.q: Size & Capacity | What is the difference between Net Weight, Rider Capacity, and Max Gross Weight Capacity?
faq.a:
- Net Weight: The standalone weight of the Lemmo 3 bike itself.
- Rider Capacity: The maximum rider weight allowed without additional cargo.
- Max Gross Weight Capacity: The maximum allowable total weight on the wheels, including the bike, rider, and all cargo.

faq.q: Size & Capacity | Can riders of significantly different heights (e.g., 155 cm and 195 cm) share the same bike comfortably?
faq.a: Yes. Lemmo 3 features extensive frame geometry adjustments to comfortably fit riders of various heights.

faq.q: Accessories | What kinds of child seats or accessories can be mounted on the 700 mm rear platform? Is it compatible with MIK HD accessories?
faq.a: The Lemmo 3 rear rack is equipped with 7 MIK-HD modules, allowing you to freely mount compatible accessories.

faq.q: Battery & Power | What is a "Semi-Solid-State Battery" and what are its advantages over traditional lithium-ion batteries?
faq.a:
Semi-solid-state battery technology is an advanced lithium battery tech widely used in high-performance EV applications. Key advantages:
- Highest energy density.
- Highest charge cycle lifespan.
- Fireproof and explosion-proof under severe impacts or punctures.

faq.q: Battery & Power | What is the real-world range of the 960 Wh battery under heavy loads?
faq.a: Under maximum load at a continuous 20 mph cruising speed, testing shows a range between 100 km (62 mi) and 120 km (75 mi). For regular daily riding, real-world range is approximately 140 km (87 mi) to 200 km (125 mi).

faq.q: Battery & Power | How long does it take to fully charge the battery, and is it removable for charging indoors?
faq.a: It takes 4.5 hours to charge the battery from 0 - 100%, and it is removable and lockable.

faq.q: Security & Connectivity | How does the V2L (Vehicle-to-Load) discharge inverter work, and what devices can I power with it?
faq.a:
The V2L discharge inverter plugs directly into the Lemmo 3 battery on one end and provides 3 output ports on the other:
- 220 V / 110 V AC output port (Max 5 A current)
- USB-C port supporting QC4.0 (Max 66 W output)
- USB-A port (Max 22 W output)
